in_sanskrit.name: Kanaram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Ganesha's attendant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kanaram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kanara means 'servant of Lord Ganesha'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known as the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom and knowledge. Kanaram is considered an assistant or attendant to Lord Ganesha, often depicted riding on his mouse vehicle.
